privacy: Raw customer prompts, answers, secrets, organization identifiers, and large logs are excluded.
score_note: decided_win_rate = wins/(wins+losses); row_win_rate = wins/n; ties and failures remain explicit.

status_definitions.canonical: Current headline evidence for its stated scope.
status_definitions.adopted: A design choice accepted from the evidence.
status_definitions.superseded: Historically valid but replaced by newer evidence.
status_definitions.invalid: Not interpretable because of a measurement or implementation defect.
status_definitions.diagnostic: Completed evidence useful for mechanism or a bounded scope, not a headline.
status_definitions.incomplete: Started but not completed on a scoreable sample.

benchmarks.title: Vendor replay on production traffic

sample.population: Two high-volume production cohorts; prompts excluded from archive

benchmarks.method: Same anonymized request IDs; checklist judge on 400 Flash rows and 398 Sonnet rows.
benchmarks.decision: Motivated owning the search loop; vendor results are supporting evidence, not Crunch claims.
limitations: Traffic mix was concentrated; this predates Crunch and the initial judge clipped answers.

benchmarks.title: Parallel Core2x replay
benchmarks.method: Production replay; stopped after repeated payment-required responses.
benchmarks.decision: Do not use as a quality result.
limitations: Incomplete and non-random survivor set.

benchmarks.title: Parallel fast variants
benchmarks.method: Planned production replay.
benchmarks.decision: Not run; archive as blocked.
limitations: Blocked by provider credits.

benchmarks.title: Planner first-hop diverse bench
benchmarks.method: Offline first-hop tool-choice comparison without retrieval.
benchmarks.decision: Prompt defaults, not only model choice, needed repair; superseded the narrow n=20 planner impression.
limitations: Org-weighted robustness sample, not traffic weighted.

benchmarks.title: Initial loop-model bake-off
benchmarks.method: Sequential same-question model bake-off; two checklist judges.
benchmarks.decision: Use gemini-3.7-flash with no deadline; Luna remains latency-relaxed runner-up.
limitations: n=20 could not reliably rank close quality arms.

benchmarks.title: Expanded shipped-config model hunt
benchmarks.method: Same 25 questions and shipped Crunch config; checklist comparisons within judge pass.
benchmarks.decision: Keep gemini-3.7-flash: no measured arm was cheaper, faster, and better.
limitations: Some slow arms were unjudged; Qwen could not honor required first-hop tools.

benchmarks.title: Native-provider cheap-model follow-up
benchmarks.method: Proposed parity replay.
benchmarks.decision: Leave as an optional offline-tier question.
limitations: Native APIs were not run; routing gain cannot close the observed 5x latency gap by itself.

benchmarks.title: Hard multi-hop benchmark
benchmarks.method: Fixed atomic criteria; independent Gemini and Fable judges.
benchmarks.decision: Treat Crunch and Exa as tied; matrix questions remain Crunch's clearest gap.
limitations: Three Crunch rows had network failures in the later fixed-write comparison; n is small.

benchmarks.title: Initial production-100 checklist run
benchmarks.method: Checklist judge with unresolved citation IDs and a 1,400-character answer clip.
benchmarks.decision: Retain only as evidence that led to harness repairs.
limitations: Citation IDs did not resolve; clipping was asymmetric.

benchmarks.title: Citation renumbering rescore
benchmarks.method: Regraded identical stored answers.
benchmarks.decision: Renumber citations after selecting emitted sources.
limitations: Measures a plumbing repair, not a model improvement.

benchmarks.title: Checklist judge answer-clip audit
benchmarks.method: Regraded identical answers.
benchmarks.decision: Invalidate pre-21-Aug cross-system magnitudes and remove asymmetric clipping.
limitations: Rankings mostly survived, but deltas did not.

benchmarks.title: Answer-contract v6/v7
benchmarks.method: Paired checklist scoring and behavior inspection.
benchmarks.decision: Adopt v7 for mechanism and reduced omissions, not as a proven pass-rate win.
limitations: Small effects sit inside judge variance.

benchmarks.title: Separate synthesis writers
benchmarks.method: Same evidence, separate writer model.
benchmarks.decision: Keep one model for loop and writing; improve the contract instead.
limitations: Targeted subset; cost deltas are decisive despite sample size.

benchmarks.title: Post-loop coverage pass
benchmarks.method: Paired checklist judge with traffic-type split.
benchmarks.decision: Keep for honest omission reduction; do not claim its task-prompt headline as quality gain.
limitations: Agentic-task gain partly rewarded citation laundering.

benchmarks.title: Forced top-page scraping
benchmarks.method: Same questions and checklist pass.
benchmarks.decision: Disable automatic top-page scraping.
limitations: No-scrape config still allows model-selected fetches.

benchmarks.title: Forced scrape hand-read pilot
benchmarks.method: Human paired read.
benchmarks.decision: Initially promising but superseded by the powered n=100 rejection.
limitations: No judge; older prompt and wider result set.

benchmarks.title: Prompt-and-tool fetch encouragement
benchmarks.method: Changed both system prompt and tool description; paired scoring.
benchmarks.decision: Keep conservative default for production; use read behavior only for analytical work.
limitations: Fetch frequency remained low; hard set was small.

benchmarks.title: Deterministic page auto-read ranking
benchmarks.method: Two replicates per arm and three judge passes.
benchmarks.decision: Leave index order as default; mechanism changed pages but not measured quality.
limitations: Ranking cannot recover an absent URL.

benchmarks.title: Host-level fetch guard
benchmarks.method: Operational replay and hand inspection.
benchmarks.decision: Permit inferred paths only on previously seen hosts.
limitations: Too rare for a pass-rate claim; can permit occasional crawling.

benchmarks.title: Hard domain filter versus broad hint
benchmarks.method: Paired runs, repeated checklist grades.
benchmarks.decision: Keep explicit user domain constraints hard.
limitations: Initial subset parser falsely matched the word 'Website:' and was corrected.

benchmarks.title: Brave as second retrieval index
benchmarks.method: Difference-in-differences using untreated rows as control.
benchmarks.decision: Do not add retrieval breadth when the evidence-read budget is the bottleneck.
limitations: Run-to-run noise was as large as candidate effects.

benchmarks.title: Toolbox result and page caps
benchmarks.method: Paired operational and checklist comparison.
benchmarks.decision: Cap results at 10 and fetched page text at 12k.
limitations: Small sample; quality result is a null.

benchmarks.title: Corrected production-100 checklist benchmark
benchmarks.method: One checklist pass after citation, clipping, prompt, coverage, and scraper fixes.
benchmarks.decision: Canonical internal-harness configuration; quality is tied with Exa on ordinary lookups.
limitations: Overall lead leans on agentic prompts; internal harness, not public crunch.py.

benchmarks.title: DeepSearchQA paired benchmark
benchmarks.method: Official-style all-correct autorater on identical questions.
benchmarks.decision: Use as evidence on exhaustive multi-step questions.
limitations: Replacement Gemini autorater prevents public leaderboard comparison.

benchmarks.title: Production traffic paired benchmark
benchmarks.method: Blind pairwise with 60 order swaps.
benchmarks.decision: Historical production result; use the stratified 2,000-row run for current claims.
limitations: 385 filtered rows excluded; older implementation.

benchmarks.title: Question-aware schema projection
benchmarks.method: Reprojected identical stored prose; one schema-validation retry.
benchmarks.decision: Include the question and validate output; projection should preserve prose quality.
limitations: DSQA explanation field reduced sensitivity.

benchmarks.title: Reciprocal-rank fusion for searchResults
benchmarks.method: Gold-answer recall at fixed cuts.
benchmarks.decision: Replace concatenation with a real ranking; later superseded by model ranking.
limitations: Only 50 DSQA rows; no exposed comparable cross-query score.

benchmarks.title: Cross-encoder score ordering
benchmarks.method: Paired gold-answer recall.
benchmarks.decision: Evidence that arrival order was wrong; raw score was later found incomparable across rewritten queries.
limitations: Recall against gold answer is not user quality.

benchmarks.title: Ranked-document head-to-head
benchmarks.method: Fixed synthesizer then pairwise judge with swaps.
benchmarks.decision: Treat as tie; ranking mechanism required a production typed-output judge.
limitations: Swap instability exceeded margin.

benchmarks.title: Explicit chain instruction A/B
benchmarks.method: Alternating paired runs, blind fixed checks.
benchmarks.decision: Preserve guess-and-verify; do not spend a turn sequencing guessable entities.
limitations: Small, model-guessable set; unknown intermediates remain untested.

benchmarks.title: 850-row prose judge with 1,800-character clip
benchmarks.method: Blind pairwise with asymmetric clipping.
benchmarks.decision: Invalidate the 61% number; raise clip to 5,000 or do not truncate.
limitations: 75% of Crunch versus 20% of Deep was clipped.

benchmarks.title: Cross-query max-score search ranking
benchmarks.method: Production 850 pilot.
benchmarks.decision: Do not compare raw reranker scores across rewritten queries.
limitations: Narrow rewrites dominated due to score-scale mismatch.

benchmarks.title: Model-ranked searchResults
benchmarks.method: Typed pairwise judge on same 850 pilot.
benchmarks.decision: Use the model to choose across sub-query result lists.
limitations: Pilot slice; canonical score comes from n=857.

benchmarks.title: SearchResults done-call finish
benchmarks.method: Sign test on paired outputs.
benchmarks.decision: End searchResults with a done call instead of writing discarded prose.
limitations: A harness initially marked answerless success rows failed.

benchmarks.title: Answer-derived status in split-finish runs
benchmarks.method: Recomputed run status.
benchmarks.decision: Derive success from typed output, not presence of prose.
limitations: Invalidated only operational status, not stored result documents.

benchmarks.title: Finish-reason-only model response
benchmarks.method: Production run interrupted by indexing an absent message.
benchmarks.decision: Make each row failure-isolated and resume-safe.
limitations: No complete result; not scoreable.

benchmarks.title: Stratified production sourcedAnswer
benchmarks.method: Blind typed pairwise Luna judge; 5,000-character clip; 60 mode swaps.
benchmarks.decision: Canonical sourcedAnswer production result.
limitations: Frozen Deep replay dropped date and domain filters.

benchmarks.title: Stratified production searchResults
benchmarks.method: Blind typed pairwise Luna judge; complete result lists.
benchmarks.decision: Canonical unfiltered searchResults result.
limitations: Frozen replay omitted request filters.

benchmarks.title: Shipping structured path
benchmarks.method: Blind typed pairwise Luna judge.
benchmarks.decision: Do not use as current structured quality; it exposed schema coercion defects.
limitations: Organization-specific format failures dominated.

benchmarks.title: Structured projector repair rescore

sample.selection: all prior Deep wins plus 100 prior Crunch wins

benchmarks.method: Stored writes reprojected with null/coercion/source fixes, then rejudged.
benchmarks.decision: Adopt projector repairs; use direct-projection confirmation for the newest architecture decision.
limitations: Selected sample; not a fresh 456-row retrieval run.

benchmarks.title: Structured abstention
benchmarks.method: Pilot ablation.
benchmarks.decision: Do not match Deep's null rate mechanically.
limitations: Small pilot; conflates several schemas.

benchmarks.title: One literal query without loop
benchmarks.method: Pilot ablation.
benchmarks.decision: Keep the adaptive loop.
limitations: Directional small slice.

benchmarks.title: Forced gather-hop count
benchmarks.method: Pilot ablation against frozen Deep.
benchmarks.decision: Let the model decide when to stop; more forced searches were not better.
limitations: Directional small slice.

benchmarks.title: Vespa-only general-web retrieval pilot
benchmarks.method: Pilot ablation.
benchmarks.decision: Do not remove external long-tail retrieval for general traffic.
limitations: Tiny slice; later enterprise Vespa results differ by traffic mix.

benchmarks.title: Gather snippets directly to schema
benchmarks.method: Projector fed unranked snippets without finished prose.
benchmarks.decision: Do not skip prose unless evidence is ranked and preserved for the projector.
limitations: Older direct path differs materially from the later ranked-evidence path.

benchmarks.title: Enterprise Toolbox Crunch versus Deep
benchmarks.method: Blind no-truncation Sonnet judge; full 100 swaps.
benchmarks.decision: Strong customer-specific evidence; not representative enough for global claim.
limitations: Single enterprise cohort; 24% swap flips.

benchmarks.title: Enterprise Vespa-only versus Deep
benchmarks.method: Blind no-truncation Sonnet judge.
benchmarks.decision: Proceed to larger Vespa confirmation.
limitations: Single cohort and small sample.

benchmarks.title: Toolbox versus Vespa-only enterprise arm
benchmarks.method: Direct blind pairwise with full swap.
benchmarks.decision: Treat retrieval arms as tied.
limitations: Swap instability greatly exceeded margin.

benchmarks.title: Enterprise Vespa-only benchmark
benchmarks.method: Blind no-truncation Sonnet judge; 200 swaps.
benchmarks.decision: Canonical enterprise-cohort result; proves Vespa-only viability on this traffic.
limitations: Single cohort; hash sample over-represents a repeated wrapper pattern; 26.5% swap flips.

benchmarks.title: Initial filtered Crunch run
benchmarks.method: Filtered replay before immutable include-domain repair.
benchmarks.decision: Invalidate v0 and constrain model-written site dorks.
limitations: Superseded before final quality judge.

benchmarks.title: Filtered production benchmark
benchmarks.method: Blind typed pairwise judge plus programmatic domain audit and 60 swaps.
benchmarks.decision: Retain immutable filters, but do not ship unchanged: filtered searchResults and empty-result handling regress.
limitations: Date compliance could not be audited from response documents; result dominated by sourcedAnswer.

benchmarks.title: Schema-guided gathering pilot
benchmarks.method: Live interleaved arms; blind two-order Gemini judge.
benchmarks.decision: Do not ship broad guidance alone: completion rose but correctness tied and latency increased.
limitations: Prior Deep-win sample; three schema families; n=40.

benchmarks.title: Schema guidance by projection substrate factorial
benchmarks.method: Fresh holdout, four interleaved live arms, blind judge in both orders.
benchmarks.decision: Direct ranked-evidence projection is promising; broad guidance itself remains unproven.
limitations: n=40; pooled order passes are not independent.

benchmarks.title: Guided direct projection confirmation
benchmarks.method: Interleaved live A/B; blind exact-schema judge; 60 reversed-order checks.
benchmarks.decision: Adopt direct ranked-evidence projection as the established lever; narrow guidance before production rollout.
limitations: Gain is concentrated in one schema family; guidance versus unguided direct remains unproven; cost rose 17.3%.
